# ARVAELLE

> ARVAELLE is a Dubai-based online jewellery store selling gold-plated necklaces and jewellery gift sets from AED 229. Every piece arrives in a signature black ARVAELLE gift box with a handwritten card. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+971 54 178 7801) and delivered across Dubai, same day for orders paid before 2 pm.

## Key facts
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates (online store)
- Products: gold-plated jewellery (necklaces, gift sets; more categories coming)
- Prices: AED 229 to AED 429
- Ordering: WhatsApp +971 54 178 7801; payment by secure link (Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard, Aani)
- Delivery: same day in Dubai if paid before 2 pm; AED 25, free over AED 400; other emirates 1-2 working days
- Packaging: black gift box, pouch, gift bag, handwritten card, no price inside
- Exchange: 7 days for unworn pieces in original packaging; 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects

## Products
- The Solstice Necklace: gold-plated rectangular pendant with an engraved starburst and a single stone. AED 249.
- The Eternal Loop Necklace: gold-plated sculptural loop pendant with a polished finish. AED 229.
- The Duo Gift Set: both necklaces in two gift boxes with one card. AED 429 (save 10%).
